transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… I guess I’m here because people keep telling me I’m making too much of things, and I don’t think I am. I know how this is going to sound, but my wife’s relative has been coming into the house, messing with my tools and my plans. Like when I’m trying to go fishing, something gets spoiled every weekend. That doesn’t just happen.

I’m not trying to make trouble or anything, doctor. I just… after months of this, it’s pretty clear to me he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Is it possible, even a little, that there could be another explanation for these things besides your wife’s relative trying to push you out?

I mean… I suppose anything’s “possible,” if that’s what I’m supposed to say. I don’t want to sound unreasonable. But honestly, doctor, no — not really.

My tools don’t just move themselves. My fishing plans don’t get messed up by accident every single weekend. And after all these months, it’s pretty plain to me that my wife’s relative came into this house to get at me. He’s trying to take over my place and push me out. I know people think I’m imagining it, but I’m not.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, not voices like that. I’m not hearing people talking when nobody’s there, if that’s what you mean.

I know I probably sound worked up about the other stuff, but it’s not like I’m hearing things. At least, I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Has he ever done something to you that you think could not happen in ordinary real life?

No, I mean… nothing like impossible, if that’s what you mean. I don’t want to sound like I’m saying something crazy.

It’s ordinary things, just too many of them to be accidents. My tools being moved, my fishing plans getting spoiled every weekend… after months of it, I can see plain as day he’s doing it to get at me. Like he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Are you completely certain that your wife’s relative is doing this on purpose?

I… yes. I’m certain.

I know that probably sounds stubborn, and I’m not trying to be difficult here, doctor. But I’m here because everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, and I’m not. My tools don’t move themselves, my fishing plans don’t get spoiled by accident every weekend, and after all these months… I can see plain as day what he’s doing.

He came into this house to get at me. He’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Have other people told you that your speech or thoughts seem confused or hard to follow?

No… not really. I mean, maybe people tell me I go on about things too much, or that I’m repeating myself, but I don’t think they’ve said I’m confused exactly.

I try to explain it clearly. If I’m not making sense, you can tell me, but I feel like I’m following what I’m saying.
Have you lost interest or motivation to do your usual activities?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I still get up and go to the plant, do my assembler work, keep the bills paid… I take care of myself like I always have.

I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is. The trouble is really centered on what’s happening at my house, with him and my things.
Before all this started, had you been diagnosed with any brain or nerve condition, like a head injury, seizures, or another neurological illness?

No, not that I know of. I mean, I’ve never been told I had anything like that before all this. No seizures or… brain condition, as far as I understand it.

I’ve always been pretty healthy that way, I think. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Did this start all of a sudden?

Not all of a sudden, no… it’s been more of a stretch of time. I’d say about nine months now, since my wife’s relative moved into our home.

I don’t want to overstate it, but that’s when I started noticing things. Does that answer what you mean by when it started?
Before these problems with your wife’s relative began, did you usually tend to distrust other people and suspect they were trying to harm or take advantage of you?

I don’t think I was like that, no. I mean, I’ve always tried to be careful with people, like anybody would, but I wouldn’t say I went around thinking people were out to hurt me or take advantage of me.

At least, not that I noticed. I got along with people well enough, I think. Is that… is that what you’re asking?
Have you noticed things that other people do not seem to notice, such as seeing something others cannot see?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t seen things that weren’t there, if that’s what you mean.

Sometimes I notice things other people don’t pay attention to, but not like seeing something nobody else can see. Does that make sense?
Have you ever felt that someone was putting thoughts into your mind?

No, I don’t think so. I’ve had worries and thoughts I don’t like, but they feel like mine, not like somebody put them there.

That’s the kind of thing you mean, right?
During this time, have you been feeling unusually high, energized, or irritable?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve been upset and on edge sometimes, sure, but not like… unusually high or full of energy.

I’m not trying to sound difficult—I just wouldn’t describe it that way. Irritable maybe a little, but I think that’s more just being under stress. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking?
During this time, have you had spells where you felt confused about where you were or what was happening around you?

No, I don’t think I’ve had anything like that. I mean, I get distracted or preoccupied sometimes, but I know where I am and what’s going on around me.

If you mean like being disoriented or not recognizing the place, then no… I wouldn’t say that’s happened.
Around the time this began, did you start any new medicines?

I don’t think so… not that I can remember. I mean, I take the usual things here and there, but I don’t recall starting some new medicine right when it began.

If there’s a specific kind you mean, I can try to think harder, but nothing is coming to mind.
Have you been using alcohol or drugs more than usual since this started?

No… I don’t think so. I mean, I might have a drink here and there like normal, but I haven’t been using drugs or drinking more because of all this.

At least, not that I’d call more than usual. Is that what you mean?
Aside from what you believe your wife’s relative is doing, have you had any other strong beliefs that other people say are not true?

No… I don’t think there’s anything else like that. I mean, the main thing is him—my wife’s relative. That’s why I’m here, really, because everybody keeps making it sound like I’m imagining it.

But I know what I’ve seen. My tools don’t just move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get messed up by accident every single weekend. After all these months, it’s pretty clear to me he’s trying to get at me, take over my place, push me out. I know that probably sounds… I don’t know, but that’s what’s been happening.
Have you become less expressive emotionally than you used to be?

I don’t think so… I mean, I try to keep myself together, maybe I’m a little quieter sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’m less emotional or anything.

My wife might say I don’t show much when I’m stressed, but I’ve kind of always been that way. Is that what you mean?
Since this started, have you been having trouble doing your work or managing things at home the way you used to?

Not really with work, no. I’m still showing up and getting things done there, and at home I’m keeping up with the usual stuff.

I guess I have changed some things, though. I don’t leave my equipment where I used to anymore, and I probably spend more time than I should locking things up or checking the workshop. I just feel better knowing things are secure. And I try not to be around him much at home, which… yeah, that’s made things tense with my wife.

But I’m managing. I don’t want to make it sound like I can’t function or anything.
